subject: Quick 15m to go over your recent usage spike — flexible times / reschedule
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Aarav Shah <aarav@neonai.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 19 Jul 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick 15m to walk through Redwood after your usage spike

Hi Aarav —

I noticed NeonAI just crossed the self-serve threshold for streaming inference this week — congrats on the ramp! A short 15-minute walkthrough would help us make sure you’re getting predictable latency and that autoscaling+KV caching settings match your traffic pattern.

Quick options (PT):
- Today 2:00–2:15 PM
- Today 3:30–3:45 PM
- Monday 9:00–9:15 AM

If none of those work, tell me two 30-minute windows and I’ll send a calendar invite. Agenda:
- 5m: what triggered the spike / expected steady-state
- 7m: config suggestions (batching, cache, quant) we can apply quickly
- 3m: next steps / AE intro for contract or Dedicated capacity if it looks needed

I attached a short runbook and a demo checklist so you can scan ahead. Marissa (AE) is cc’d, I’ll pull her in if we want to discuss committed capacity.

Thanks — looking forward to finding a time.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra | Sales Development Representative
Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0183

Attachments: redwood-runbook.pdf (2 pages), demo-checklist.pdf (1 page)

Subject: Re: Quick 15m to walk through Redwood after your usage spike

Thanks Rishi — appreciate the fast follow.

We definitely want to talk; the spike was from a batch ingestion test and we expect similar bursts for the next two quarters. 2:00 PM today is tight for me — can we do 4:00–4:30 PM PT instead? If possible, I’d prefer a 30-minute slot so we can also talk briefly about a couple of security/retention questions.

Also: could you include a short agenda and any pointers for performance metrics we should pull before the call?

Cheers,
Aarav
Aarav Shah | Head of Platform
NeonAI
aarav@neonai.com
